map.根据镜头数量、复杂度等级、平均镜头长度与团队规模估算 VFX 制作时长与制作预算: Estimate VFX production duration and budget from shot count, complexity level, average shot length and team size, supporting schedule discussion and quote review.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：totalSeconds ÷ 60；totalHou: Key formula (by input variables): totalSeconds ÷ 60; totalHours ÷ 8
map.简单×1.0、中等×1.5、复杂×2.8、高难×5.0、极难×8.0。复杂度越高: Simple ×1.0, Medium ×1.5, Complex ×2.8, Hard ×5.0, Extreme ×8.0. Higher complexity multiplies the work hours and cost per shot.

map.电影后期团队常用该估算在报价前建立“镜头口径 + 成本口径”，用于判断排期是否可: Post-production film teams commonly use this estimate to build a "shot caliber + cost caliber" before quoting, to judge whether the schedule is controllable.
map.按镜头类型（擦除/绿幕/CG/粒子/破坏/角色）分组后计算可快速识别高风险镜头与: Grouping by shot type (cleanup / greenscreen / CG / particles / destruction / character) then calculating quickly identifies high-risk shots and over-budget factors.
map.在跨团队复核时，统一复杂度系数和人均日薪口径，可避免同一项目不同部门口径不一致。: In cross-team review, unifying the complexity coefficient and per-person daily-wage caliber avoids inconsistency between departments on the same project.
map.输入 30 镜头、每镜头 4 秒、复杂度=复杂（2.8）、每镜头基础工时 6 小: Input 30 shots, 4 s per shot, complexity = Complex (2.8), 6 base work hours per shot, 8-person team, daily wage 1600 CNY: project labor = 504 h, project schedule ≈ 7.9 days, project budget ≈ 84,000 CNY.
map.将高复杂度镜头提前做技术预演，优化到中等工艺后可将复杂度系数从 5.0 降到 3: Do a tech preview early for high-complexity shots; after optimizing to medium process, the complexity coefficient can drop from 5.0 to 3.5, quickly simulating and comparing schedule and budget differences across plans.
map.复杂度系数要如何标注？: How should the complexity coefficient be annotated?
map.建议先定义标准表，按历史镜头交付内容归类（擦除、合成、CG生物、角色动画等），再: It is recommended to define a standard table first, classify by historical shot deliverables (cleanup, composite, CG creature, character animation, etc.), then take the average correction value of samples from the last 3–5 months.
map.该结果可直接作为最终报价吗？: Can this result be used directly as the final quote?
map.可作为技术初估结果。正式报价前应叠加返工率、审批率、评审周转和管理冗余后再提交商: It can serve as a technical preliminary estimate. Before formal quoting, overlay rework rate, approval rate, review turnaround and management buffer, then submit the commercial version.
